title: Confidence-Aware Robust Edge EMS: Reproducibility Software for Risk-Calibrated Multiobjective Tuning
description: Documentation/provenance synchronization release for the reproducibility software supporting confidence-aware, risk-calibrated, multiobjective tuning of an edge-executable battery-supported microgrid energy-management system. The scientific evidence chain remains frozen; this patch synchronizes the published Zenodo identifiers, manuscript v10 provenance, and archival metadata without changing experimental results.
